chunks: What al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, concerning:

About a man who forgot Tawaf al-Nisa' until he came to al-Kufah, he said: Women do not become lawful for him until he performs tawaf of the House. I said: Then if he is not able? He said: He should instruct someone to perform tawaf on his behalf.

key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: the Sacred House, meaning the Ka'bah
key_terms.طَوَافَ النِّسَاءِ: the tawaf whose completion makes marital relations lawful after hajj rites
key_terms.لَا تَحِلُّ: does not become lawful or permissible
key_terms.لَمْ يَقْدِرْ: is unable or lacks the ability to perform it personally
key_terms.يَطُوفُ عَنْهُ: performs the tawaf on his behalf

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets Tawaf al-Nisa' and returns home before performing it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding one who forgets Tawaf al-Nisa' and returns home before performing it. His marital relations remain unlawful until the tawaf is completed, and if he cannot perform it himself, he appoints someone to do it on his behalf.
